from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Citation information for one paper in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_from_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper cites in its reference list")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    paper_citation_infos: list[PaperCitationInfo]
